name: Maki Seina
source:
A first-year who fell in love with her kind upperclassman, Aihara Miki, after their first meeting.

A dreamy girl who prioritizes the "mood" of things, like enrolling at Shirojo just because "It's so cool that it was built in a castle!" Like a new student should, she appears reserved, but she can actually be quite pushy.

The type who wants to leap into the arms of her lover.

Strength: Stronger than she looks
Weakness: Unbalanced diet
Hobbies: Collecting accessories, shopping
Skill: Carpentry

[Taken from the [url=http://mangagamer.org/kindredspirits/]English official website[/url]]
